taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Bank-road, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Bank-road, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Bank-road Station, Bori Metropolis**

The vertical electrical sounding at Bank-road resolved a four-layer subsurface sequence with resistivities increasing steadily with depth: Layer 1 (640 Ω·m, 0–5.21 m), Layer 2 (934 Ω·m, 5.21–13.8 m), Layer 3 (2594 Ω·m, 13.8–97.9 m), and Layer 4 (4386 Ω·m, below 97.9 m, inferred as basement or a resistive substratum).

Applying the standard curve-type convention: for layers 1-2-3, r1 < r2 < r3, giving "A"; for layers 2-3-4, r2 < r3 < r4, also giving "A". The correct curve-type designation is therefore "AA" (equivalently "A"), not the "AK" type currently on file. The on-file classification appears to be a labeling error, as no resistivity inversion (required for a K-type letter) occurs anywhere in the sequence. Recommend correcting the station record to reflect the true A-type curve before use in drilling target selection.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
